% Pattern: number/within. \newtheorem of the amsthm package, loaded in an AMS
% class, with an empty counter in the brackets prints its number with a 0
% before it, as the LaTeX kernel does. Seen in the gold pilot (set X).
% want theorem-1 statement/theorem 01
% want lemma-1 statement/lemma 02
\documentclass{amsart}
\usepackage{amsthm}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}[]
\newtheorem{lemma}[theorem]{Lemma}
\begin{document}
\section{One}
\begin{theorem} Every compact space is bounded. \end{theorem}
\begin{lemma} Every finite space is compact. \end{lemma}
\end{document}
